quote: We measure the degree of inter-annotator agreement between learners and ground truth labels...

We recruited learners at various levels of proficiency in English (high-resource), Korean (mid-resource), and Indonesian (low-resource). They annotated data on four tasks, sentiment analysis (SA), natural language inference (NLI), named entity recognition (NER), and machine reading comprehension (MRC).
guideline: Participants solve 15 test questions to check their language proficiency level. All test questions are multiple-choice types and include the "I don't know" option.
